description: Twelve outputs at fixed voltages a twelfth of a volt apart, one chromatic octave for a module tracking 1V per octave.

outputs.text: A steady voltage for C in the octave picked on the menu, 0V with the default octave.
A steady voltage for C sharp in the octave picked on the menu, 0.083333V with the default octave.
A steady voltage for D in the octave picked on the menu, 0.166667V with the default octave.
A steady voltage for D sharp in the octave picked on the menu, 0.25V with the default octave.
A steady voltage for E in the octave picked on the menu, 0.333333V with the default octave.
A steady voltage for F in the octave picked on the menu, 0.416667V with the default octave.
A steady voltage for F sharp in the octave picked on the menu, 0.5V with the default octave.
A steady voltage for G in the octave picked on the menu, 0.583333V with the default octave.
A steady voltage for G sharp in the octave picked on the menu, 0.666667V with the default octave.
A steady voltage for A in the octave picked on the menu, 0.75V with the default octave.
A steady voltage for A sharp in the octave picked on the menu, 0.833333V with the default octave.
A steady voltage for B in the octave picked on the menu, 0.916667V with the default octave.

menu: Octave — a submenu running from Octave -5 to Octave 4, picking which octave the twelve outputs are taken from.
Visuals — a submenu of Blue, Dark and Light for the colour scheme, plus Flat for a look without the 3D shading. The choice covers every SubmarineFree module and is kept outside the patch.
